content: Nzam anà un'sɛŋ kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde
Amu Klistɔ mɛ in'tɛn ndandaa, mɛ in'kur anki, u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, an'kyän amɛ man'tɛɛlà imbäl:
u mpem amɛ, mɛ in'we anà ngyɛb mbɔɔn anà usaay mpa bàfàtsü.
Ɛɛ, mɛ in'yàkwen naa ban'si in'küül, mɛ ŋakwo in'kaabà anà Klistɔ ntɔn atɔŋ amɛ, itoo amɛ u ndür.
Ba bà baar a Isàlɛl, abà unsà ngywaaŋ a nkà, làkoo, nkwà, nkɔ̈ɔ̈n, ngyamàkà, ilää
anà bàtaa, amu ba, unsà ndür, kàtoo Klistɔ awà udu a ya yanswà, Nzam aŋàsaak ipepey. Yà abwɛy!
Ya ikaswaŋà anki naa Ndaa a Nzam iböŋ anki. Ntɔn, baar banswà abà akyee a Isàlɛl kà Bà Isàlɛl anki,
anà, kà akyee a Abàlam banswà anki abà baan ande, ntɔn Nzam kàtɛn a Abàlam naa: « Ngye akyee asàwal u mbwo a Isak. »
Ikaswaŋà naa: kà baan a ndür anki unsà imbuur abà baan a Nzam. Baan a Nzam bà baan abà kàbɔ̈r nde uboo ilää kun'pɛ nde.
Ntɔn, ndaa ayi yàkäl ilää: « Mɛ in'kyer asàyàfurà u paŋà atub alà, Saal asàkal anà mwan baal. »
Kà yàtsü apan anki, Lɛbɛk sye kàbör baan a mbuur mwɛy mpɛl, Isak, taaràbi.
Apan, baan bàkäl anki bàŋàtàbɔr anà bàŋàtàkyer anki itàkal ubwaŋ, itàkal ube, ntɔn nswaal a Nzam ikwe, ndaa yàkäl kusà a nsɔ̈ɔ̈l kàkyer nde
mukɔɔn alab isal a baar, wɛɛ ukwen a mbuur kabel, waa kàtɛn a Lɛbɛk naa: "Bwel asàsyääl un'kɔm",
asànaa bàsön naa:

content.text: Ininà bi itɛn? Nkye balàbal latɛy amu Nzam? Kà ndandaa anki! »

content: Ntɔn nde kàtɛn a Mɔsɛ naa:

content.text: anà in'sàpà kab a ngway akà mbuur an'kwen mɛ mupà kab a ngway.
Abun, ndaa ayi ifàkal anki ntɔn ukwen itàkal ngwal a mbuur, wɛɛ u nsyääm a Nzam.
Kyakin Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yàtɛn ya a Falawɔ naa: « Le, mɛ kasi mɛ mfum ntɔn muswaŋ amu ngye ngwal amɛ, ntɔn naa ikɔb amɛ bàkyään kya u mɛɛn manswà. »
Abun, nde afàsyääm mbuur ukwen nde, afàsà mpem bwoor akà mbuur ukwen nde.

content: Nkyɛl anà ngyɛb a Nzam
Wɛɛ abun, ngye ayàtɛn a mɛ naa: « Ntɔn nkye ufiŋään nde, ntɔn, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mumbäär ukwen ande? »
Wɛɛ ngye awà nà, mbuur, ntɔn musà Nzam mbaaŋ? Nkye làbuuŋ lan'kwo làtɛn a un'boom ande naa: « Ntɔn nkye kan'kyer ngye abà? »
Un'boom, kà wà mfum a tɔm ande anki mukyer a twar nsil alan, làbuuŋ a ibyääl, itàkal làbuuŋ a isal a bunàbun?
Ngye ininà atɛn, isàkal naa Nzam akwen mutwey nkyɛl ande anà muswaŋ ngwal ande, nde kàkyer asɛn buur anà nkääŋ a mpem mbɔɔn an'buuŋ a nkyɛl balɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn ukwà,
ayi yà ntɔn nde mumɛɛy un'naaŋ a làkoo ande akà an'buuŋ a un'naaŋ ande kusà a an'buuŋ a nsyääm kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde kusà ntɔn làkoo.
Bi ibà baar kàbel nde, kà nà uboo Ayudà mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye uboo a baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Asànaa, un'kaan a Ɔzɛ utɛɛnà wa naa:

content.text: Awà mpa kàkäl un'sɛŋ amɛ, mɛ in'sun'beelà un'sɛŋ amɛ,
awà mpa kàkäl nkween amɛ, mɛ in'sun'beelà nkwen amɛ.
Ikal akyä bàtɛɛnà a ba naa: « Bɛ kà làbà un'sɛŋ amɛ anki »,
ba bàsabeelà baan a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈.

content: Yɛsay, u mper yànde, kàsi un'kwɛŋ ntɔn Isàlɛl: « Itàkal naa baan a Isàlɛl bàkäl asànaa ansɛŋ a ngyäl a kölàköl, baar ikikye bàsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntɔn Mwol asàkwey Ndaa ande yanswà làgyägyä u mɛɛn. »
Yɛsay awà kàtàtà ngɔɔm kusà naa:

content.text: « Isàkal naa Mwol a aŋità kàsiwɛy anki ikyee,

content: Isàlɛl anà ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈
Apanà, ininà bi ifàtɛn? Ayi: baar mpa abà Ayudà, mpa bàleŋà mubulà bàbalàbal, bàkyàwal balàbal lan'fà u làkwikilà,
kyekà Isàlɛl awà kàleŋà un'kɔɔn ntɔn mubulà balàbal, kàsàman anki la.
Ntɔn nkye? Ntɔn balàbal alà ba la bàyadilà anki unsà làkwikilà, wɛɛ ba bàsii naa ba la bàsawal unsà isal. Ba bàyàböl akà « un'kul awà afàbwiy »,
abun, bàsön naa:

content.text: « Le, mɛ kan'tɔɔl u Siyɔnà un'kul afàbwiy,
Wɛɛ mbuur afàsà làkwikilà amu Nde usàman anki nswɛn. »
